text: 僕もそれ読んでて、日本人ぽいオチの付け方だなぁと思ってました。

最後ウケる
While we were busy fixing the linker to save 1MB, iOS 15 launched and quietly gave us 35MB more.
Thanks, iOS!

attachments.title: Hey linker, can you spare a meg?
attachments.text: Tailscale on iOS runs as a special kind of app, a Network Extension. This lets us run in the background, so we can secure traffic from all of your applications, without them having to change anything. But with this power comes a memory straightjacket. Normal iOS apps can use 5GB or so of memory before iOS kills them. We get 15MB. With an “M”.
